kfn_real_pois.description: kFN query: exact results while pruning the search space. Scored on machine-independent metrics: accuracy and candidate reduction ratio.
kfn_real_pois.notes: Rows named colt_phl and aub_phl summarize paper-reported reference behavior. The colt_us48_repro row is the fixed shipped-benchmark target from the US48/synthetic-POI replacement setting, refreshed after the post-audit regeneration job on 2026-05-20.

candidates_ratio.description: Fraction of objects requiring exact distance verification. Lower = more efficient pruning.

candidate_p90_ratio.description: 90th-percentile fraction of objects retrieved on the slice, penalizing methods that only optimize average-case pruning.

candidate_max_ratio.description: Worst per-query fraction of objects retrieved on the slice, catching brittle pruning on hard queries.

lookup_reduction_vs_brute.description: How many fewer distance lookups vs brute force (brute=1.0). Machine-independent speed proxy.

aknn_real_pois.description: AkNN query correctness and candidate reduction for multiple query vertices.
aknn_real_pois.notes: The colt_phl row summarizes paper-reported reference behavior. The colt_us48_repro row is the fixed shipped-benchmark target from the US48/synthetic-POI replacement setting, refreshed after the post-audit regeneration job on 2026-05-20.

accuracy.description: Exact-match correctness vs brute force for AkNN queries.

candidates_ratio.description: Fraction of objects examined during AkNN query. Lower = more efficient pruning.

candidate_p90_ratio.description: 90th-percentile fraction of objects examined, detecting methods tuned only for easy AkNN queries.

candidate_max_ratio.description: Worst per-query fraction of objects examined, detecting brittle AkNN pruning.

range_real_pois.description: Range query correctness and candidate reduction.
range_real_pois.notes: The colt_phl row summarizes paper-reported reference behavior. The colt_us48_repro row is the fixed shipped-benchmark target from the US48/synthetic-POI replacement setting, refreshed after the post-audit regeneration job on 2026-05-20.

accuracy.description: Exact-match correctness vs brute force for range queries.

candidates_ratio.description: Fraction of objects examined during range query. Lower = more efficient pruning.

candidate_p90_ratio.description: 90th-percentile fraction of objects examined, detecting methods tuned only for easy range queries.

candidate_max_ratio.description: Worst per-query fraction of objects examined, detecting brittle range-query pruning.

preprocessing.notes: Timing metrics are retained only as zero-weight diagnostics. The colt_us48_repro row is from the shipped replacement benchmark and should not be read as a paper-reported number.

sul_time_s.description: SUL-Tree build time in seconds, reported for diagnostics only because wall-clock speed is hardware-dependent.

col_time_s.description: COL-Tree build time in seconds, reported for diagnostics only because wall-clock speed is hardware-dependent.
